normalizationRules.source: formal theorem target only; no natural-language expansion
normalizationRules.matching: longest notation first, left-to-right deterministic scan
normalizationRules.multiplicity: count every notation occurrence before deduplication
normalizationRules.minus: unary after start or one of ( , : = →; binary otherwise

morphologyRules.zero: emit only for a standalone formal numeral 0
morphologyRules.one: emit only for a standalone formal numeral 1
morphologyRules.assoc: emit only in an equality when add/mul/comp/relation_comp occurs at least three times
morphologyRules.comm: emit only for exact two-variable swapped equality under + or *
morphologyRules.self: emit only for exact x - x = 0 shape

relationRules.inference: exact formal identifiers only; never infer a property from prose or theorem name

benchmarkApplication.candidateGeneration: ephemeral union augmentation from existing declaration metadata matching semantic tokens
benchmarkApplication.selectorEvidence: semantic overlap contributes one experimental structural evidence signal
